title: Square Enix confirms release date and details for Final Fantasy VII Revelation for 2027
summary: The third part of the FF7 remake will arrive in April 2027 with open world, Sephiroth and Vincent DLCs, and a Switch 2 version in game-key card format.

title: Sony and Microsoft refuse to refund money over tariffs and ask for lawsuits to be dismissed
summary: Both companies argue they have no legal obligation to pass tariff refunds to consumers, generating multiple class-action lawsuits.

title: Crimson Desert announces first expansion 'Charting the Unknown' with Sims-like mechanics for October
summary: The DLC adds settlement management and daily life to the open world, significantly changing the gameplay of Pearl Abyss's Action RPG.

title: Xbox Game Pass limits cloud gaming hours starting September, affecting 4% of users
summary: Microsoft imposes a monthly cloud streaming cap for Game Pass Ultimate subscribers, justifying it by low current usage of the feature.

title: Final Fantasy Resonance surprises with playable demo on Switch and retro style that wins over critics
summary: Square Enix's new RPG combines 16-bit aesthetics with modern mechanics, receiving praise for its balance between nostalgia and innovation.

title: PlayStation State of Play September 2026 reveals Metro 2039, Monster Hunter Ascendance, Ghost of Yotei and more
summary: The event showed trailers and key release dates for 2027, including new IPs and major expansions for PS5 and PC.

title: CD Projekt confirms The Witcher 4 will be developed 'predominantly by people' and not with generative AI
summary: The Polish studio rejects using AI to create full content, while The Witcher 1 remake remains on hold until the sequel is finished.

title: New details on Resident Evil 9 and movie: director avoids extravagant lore and clip shows extreme violence
summary: Zach Cregger seeks a more grounded approach for the next installment, while the film shows scenes of real high stakes for the protagonist.

title: Frontier Developments (Planet Coaster) announces Disney game, likely a theme park simulator
summary: The studio behind Planet Coaster and Jurassic World Evolution collaborates with Disney to create a new title based on its intellectual properties.

title: Naughty Dog distances itself from The Last of Us season 3 but assures the saga continues
summary: Neil Druckmann explains that the HBO series will make creative decisions without his direct involvement, though the studio has more projects underway.

title: ArenaNet reveals Guild Wars 3 with smaller-scale combat and innovative movement to revitalize the MMO genre
summary: The studio aims to break the genre's stagnation with 20-player encounters and a unique movement system, moving away from traditional massive battles.

title: The Blood of Dawnwalker releases temporary fixes for its four main issues on PC and a mod triples the timer
summary: Developers offer workarounds for launch bugs, while the community creates mods to reduce time counter pressure.

title: Blizzard hints at new StarCraft with cryptic messages and all signs point to announcement at BlizzCon
summary: Multiple sources agree the real-time strategy franchise would return after years of silence, possibly revealed at Blizzard's convention.

title: Tim Sweeney warns of 'worst crash since the 80s' and proposes building more factories as solution
summary: Epic Games CEO describes a severe crisis in the video game industry and suggests increasing hardware production capacity as response.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword arrives on PC and consoles with technical analysis, hard mode and good performance on Steam Deck
summary: Capcom's saga return receives positive reviews for its action and humor, though its open world is criticized for being repetitive.

title: Dragon's Dogma 2 developers admit Western and Japanese players seek different experiences
summary: Capcom team acknowledges difficulties balancing game friction, as the West values it while Japan prefers fewer obstacles.

title: Digimon Story: Time Stranger to receive major expansion in 2027 titled 'A Hero's Eternal Legacy'
summary: Bandai Namco announces additional content for the monster RPG, extending its story and adding new mechanics for next year.

title: PlayStation Plus adds four new games for 2026, including a day-one launch
summary: Sony reveals more titles coming to the subscription service, highlighting the inclusion of a game available from its release.

title: Sony releases Lego set of original PlayStation with functional disc reader at scale
summary: The detailed replica of the 1994 console includes controller, memory card and a disc that can be inserted, available for pre-order soon.

title: New Castlevania: Belmont's Curse trailer excites fans with 'Bloody Tears' theme and classic aesthetic
summary: The Metroidvania-style game shows its gameplay and iconic music, generating great anticipation among fans of the Konami saga.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World shows 'Monster Wrangler' trailer with creature capture and synthesis
summary: Square Enix's spin-off reveals monster capture and fusion mechanics in a new world, with release planned for 2025.

title: Monster Hunter Ascendance reveals new elder dragon, floating region and character redesign in extended trailer
summary: Capcom shows substantial gameplay of its next title, highlighting a vertical ecosystem and the return of a classic character with notable changes.

title: Ghost of Yotei brings back Jin Sakai in a roguelike mode called 'Most Wanted' for the Complete Edition
summary: The Ghost of Tsushima sequel will include additional content allowing players to play again with the original protagonist in procedurally generated challenges.

title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 bets heavily on RPG elements in new 'Fight Your Way' trailer
summary: Bandai Namco shows advances of the fighting game, highlighting deeper character progression and improved customization systems.

title: Miyazaki denies foot fetish in Elden Ring and attributes design to 'representing human nature'
summary: FromSoftware director responds to memes about abundance of feet in the game, while players report connection issues in Nightreign spin-off.

title: GTA 6 will revolutionize vehicle theft and arrive with limited edition DualSense controllers for PS5
summary: Rockstar redesigns car theft mechanic and Sony launches two themed controllers, while fishing and hunting systems different from expected are detailed.

title: Nvidia DLSS 5 enables 'neural rendering' of characters in almost any game, generating controversy over its use on real faces
summary: The new upscaling technology can insert AI-generated characters into matches, blurring the line between rendered graphics and deepfakes.

title: Creative Assembly confirms Alien: Isolation 2 will ignore film sequels and shows demo at Gamescom
summary: The survival horror sequel will focus only on the original 1979 film, and its behind-closed-doors test promises atmospheric terror in a new planetary environment.
